message: Workouts now have programs: routines done in turn, with the next one worked out from the workouts you finish. Start from one of four ready-made programs or make your own, and link a task to a program so its Workout button starts whatever is next. In a workout, each exercise suggests its next weight from last time, with the reason, and one tap fills it in. Routines can warm up with a ramp worked out from the working weight, and exercises can now be edited from their page.
